question: As of December 2020, who among the following is the Governor of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ganesh Lal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• About Odisha (all information as of Jan 2022)

 
 
• CM: Naveen Patnaik
 
• Governor: Ganeshi Lal
 
• State Flower: Ashoka
 
• State Animal: Elephant
 
• **State Tree: **Banyan
 
• Highest Peak: Deomali
 
• National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries: Similipal National Park, Bhitarkanika NP, Badrama WS, Baisipalli WS, Balukhand Konark WS, Chandaka Dampara WS, Chilika Nalaban WP.
 
• **UNESCO sites:** **Sun temple of Konark** is the only and most renowned temple of Odisha and is a **World Heritage Site inscribed in 1984 as a cultural property of India.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governors of other states: **(as of May 2021)

 
 
• Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar: **Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• Jagdish Mukhi: **Assam.**
 
• Acharya Devvrat: **Gujarat.**
